summary.name: Panic
summary.one_liner: Panic is a software and game company that makes Mac and iOS apps for developers (Nova, Transmit, Prompt), publishes video games, and makes the Playdate handheld console.
use_cases: Editing code on a Mac with a native code editor
Transferring files to servers over SFTP, FTP, or S3
Connecting to remote servers with an SSH terminal on Mac, iPhone, or iPad
Buying indie video games for PC, console, or Mac
Buying the Playdate handheld gaming system
summary.what_it_does: The page is the homepage of Panic, which lists several product lines. For developers, it offers Nova, a native Mac code editor, Transmit, a macOS SFTP, FTP and S3 client, and Prompt, a native SSH terminal emulator for Mac, iPhone, iPad and visionOS. Several of these support Panic Sync. The company also publishes video games across platforms, including Big Walk, Blippo+, Herdling, Time Flies, despelote, Arco and Thank Goodness You're Here!. It also sells the Playdate, a small yellow handheld console with a crank. The page includes a support section with docs, serial number retrieval and older app downloads.
notable: Nova, a native Mac code editor listed under IDEs on awesome-mac
Prompt, a native SSH terminal for Mac, iPhone, iPad and visionOS
Playdate, a tiny yellow handheld console with a crank
Publishes indie games such as Untitled Goose Game and Firewatch
caveats: Pricing for individual apps and games is not stated on the page; each product has a Buy Now option.
Some apps and games are available only on specific platforms, such as Mac-only or Mac App Store releases.
Panic Sync is referenced but its details are not explained on this page.
